tijori.business_description: Symbiotec Pharmalab Ltd., incorporated in 2002, is a pharmaceutical and biotechnology company manufacturing steroidal APIs, nutritional ingredients and specialty products. Its business spans organic chemistry, biotechnology and complex injectables, serving pharmaceutical, nutraceutical and wellness markets.
